summary: This lecture from Zadul-Ma'ad (Provisions for the Hereafter) Part 29 discusses the virtues of Friday (Yawm al-Jumu'ah) in Islam, explaining how Allah has given this day special significance for the Muslim ummah, just as He appointed Saturday for the Jews and Sunday for Christians. Sh. Ali Mashhour uses the parable of hired workers to illustrate how Allah chose to give the Muslim nation particular blessings and virtues without wronging previous nations. The lecture emphasizes that Friday contains a special hour in which sincere du'a is accepted, and explores the spiritual superiority of this day in Islamic tradition.

catchy_title: Why Friday is Islam's Most Blessed Day
